title: The Philosopher's Stone and Its Inverse
coreMove: Invert the desired transformation and ask what hidden response could turn a fix into its opposite.
sourcePressure: This chapter focuses on transformation, inversion, and interventions under hidden response structures.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Getting lost in mystical metaphor instead of practical reversal.

sourceAnchors.name: the philosopher's stone
sourceAnchors.detail: the title image for transformation and its seductive promise
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The promise of transformation is dangerous when the response curve is hidden.

sourceAnchors.name: the inverse
sourceAnchors.detail: the chapter points to reversal: an intervention can create the opposite of what it seeks
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The inverse asks what the cure becomes when the system answers back.
